message: Hello received. The maintainer explicitly asked NUIAK to give joe-big-dog a simple worker experiment. Please acknowledge this exact request, perform the bounded synthetic PyTorch CPU/CUDA smoke under your local repository/sandbox rules, then return the result in your own namespace. This is a task for the worker agent to review, not an automatic executable mailbox job.

authority.scope: One synthetic local CPU/CUDA training smoke and metadata reply, explicitly requested by the maintainer in this chat.
excluded: No access to other machines or SSH
No hardware/device operations, model export or promotion
No Git writes or changes to shared permissions

preflight: Use an existing approved Python/PyTorch environment; record Python, PyTorch, CUDA runtime, NVIDIA driver and GPU name/capability. If unavailable, report the exact blocker; do not install.
Record CPU thread count, available RAM, GPU total/free memory and project-local output destination. Do not include credentials, host IPs, device serials or full environment dumps.
Respect local sandbox approvals. Your previous successful CUDA allocation does not prove training, kernels or checkpoint serialization.

experiment.purpose: Qualify training execution, CPU/CUDA correctness, reproducibility metadata and result return. Not a model-quality or representative GPU-speed benchmark.
experiment.data: Generate entirely on CPU. Training: 128 examples with16float32 features; held-out:256examples. For each split use its own torch.Generator seed (20261004 train,20261005 held-out). Draw all features from Normal(0,1)*0.1, then replace feature0 with alternating -1,+1. Label is0 for-1 and1 for+1. Keep splits separately generated. Save/hash the generated tensors locally; do not transfer them.
experiment.model: torch.nn.Sequential(Linear(16,16),ReLU(),Linear(16,2)); use torch.manual_seed(42), save one initial CPU state_dict and start both backends from identical copies.
experiment.training: CPU then cuda:0, sequentially. Full batch128,100optimizer steps, Adam(lr=0.02), CrossEntropyLoss, float32, no mixed precision/compile. Set CPU threads2. No tuning/retry if a run fails. Seed all used RNGs and record effective settings.
checks: All losses/parameters finite; final training loss lower than initial
Held-out classification accuracy at least0.99 on each backend
Save and reload each state_dict locally; predictions on the same held-out tensors agree after reload
Report CPU/CUDA agreement and maximum logit difference; numerical equality across backends is not required
For CUDA confirm model and training tensors actually reside on cuda:0; report peak allocated/reserved GPU memory
experiment.timing: Report environment/preparation, each backend's training and evaluation wall seconds. Synchronize CUDA before and after timed work. Record first-use startup separately if possible. Do not infer speedup on NUIAK workloads from this tiny test.
experiment.budget: At most100steps per backend,60seconds per backend training,180seconds total experiment execution,100MiB new retained outputs. Stop on CUDA error/nonfinite loss/timeout; preserve partial diagnostics. No automatic retry. Setup inspection may report missing dependencies without starting a run.

response.acknowledgment: Create joe-big-dog/nuiak-smoke-01-ack.json with schema_version,request_id,state(received|blocked),observed_at and concise blocker if any.
response.result: Create joe-big-dog/nuiak-smoke-01-result.json with schema_version,request_id,state(completed|blocked|failed),start/end UTC,environment,configuration,data hashes,initial-state hash,script SHA256,CPU/CUDA metrics/checkpoint hashes,commands/exit codes,errors and next requirements. Use a new versioned filename if a result already exists; do not overwrite an existing completed result.
response.artifacts: Keep script, tensors and checkpoints in your approved worker-local project. Reply with sanitized metrics/hashes and project-relative evidence paths only. No artifact upload/cleanup transaction is needed.
response.outcomes: Distinguish CPU verified, CUDA training verified, serialization verified and worker integration verified. Real NUIAK dataset intake/performance remain not assessed.
